## New server requirements

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/DNSCrypt/dnscrypt-resolvers/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) before submitting this pull request.
- [ ] I tested the server (with dnscrypt-proxy) before submitting this PR.

- [ ] The server is not a frontend for another DNS service.
